items.title: Albert Burbank Interview, 1962-01-04
items.q: I used to play a lot of spot jobs with Percy Humphrey.

ctx.x: Yeah, dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear…

I like world rules and I like high society too. Do you like a lot of marches? No. No. I like Timberlaine. I like Timberlaine too. It's good. Several others are. I like Barry, no. I just can't think of them now. I've been in Gettysburg, you like that? Yeah. What about punch? Did you ever play with punch much? I never played with punch. I believe the only time I played with punch was on an advertisement. You know, like they used to advertise on a Sunday evening for a dance, at night, for a couple of hours. That's…
I know Bill Russell told me that you wanted to record with Percy. What's that? Bill Russell had told me that you wanted to record with Percy. Way back.
